pinned_llama.graph_and_offload: llama-bench on the pinned authority used n_gpu_layers=99, CUDA backend, flash_attn auto (-1), type_k/v f16, n_ctx 4096 for decode oracles. Graph capture is llama's internal CUDA-graph evaluate/capture, not a Quartz decode_segments8 equivalent.

metric_catalog.first_sampled_token_reason: Prefill (or the previous decode eval) already produced logits for the last prompt token. Sampling that token does not require a new eval. ranked.reason: OPT-117 recapture on frontier/GDN pointer changes is a source-grounded graph-input instability. Missing profiling does not block this correctness prerequisite.
Recapture-free replay is the mechanism that can convert OPT-126 into request time. Quantify after stable inputs; do not treat ~10 ms leaf gaps as the recapture savings.

Host stalls overlapping GPU execution must not be counted twice. Leaf-gap ~10 ms/token is unobserved, not proven CPU-submission starvation. Proceed only after OPT-125 activity traces attribute true inactive spans.

Matched decode-only D2048 still trails pinned llama after boundary correction, but 0.620× was a mixed-boundary whole-engine ratio and is not an attention component ratio. Component replay is required; shipping hybrid_crossover@1024 stays.
No matched attention-component candidate is frozen. OPT-129 must name at most two causal transfers before implementation.
Residual launch-chain fusion is only justified after graph, host, and attention verdicts. OPT-119 already kept norm→Q8.

answers.is_10ms_per_token_true_inactive_reason: The ~10 ms/token figure is the OPT-115/124 leaf-gap remainder after event-union busy time, not an independent CUPTI/Nsight proof of hardware inactivity. Relabeled unobserved. Proven inactive ms/token=0.0.
answers.causally_removable_reason: Only API-correlated proven device-inactive spans are removable host/submission time. Source-grounded graph (OPT-126/127) and attention (OPT-129) work may still proceed without that number.
